nodes.title: Exports time out for large workspaces
nodes.description:
## Context

Customers on the **Enterprise** plan report that exports time out after 30 seconds when a workspace has more than 10k rows.

## Repro

1. Open a workspace with a large table
2. Click **Export → CSV**
3. Wait

```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM export_jobs WHERE status = 'running';
```
